name: skillshare-codebase-audit
description: >- Cross-validate CLI flags, docs, tests, and targets for consistency across the codebase. Use this skill whenever the user asks to: audit the codebase, check for consistency issues, find undocumented flags, verify test coverage, validate targets.yaml, check handler split conventions, or verify oplog instrumentation. This is a read-only audit — it reports issues but never modifies files. Use after large refactors, before releases, or whenever you suspect docs/code/tests have drifted out of sync.
author: runkids
